# YouTube.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · **Deutsch** · [Français](README.fr.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md)

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/youtube-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/youtube-scraper.md)

Beispiel-Scraper für öffentliche Videos, Kanäle, Kommentare, Suchergebnisse und Shorts von YouTube.com, geschrieben in Python mit der Web-Scraping-API von [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Teil von [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.de.md).

- **Anleitung:** [How to Scrape YouTube in 2025](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-youtube)
- **Code:** [`youtube.py`](youtube.py) · **Beispielaufruf:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Beispielausgabe:** [Channel videos](results/channel_videos.json) · [Channel metadata](results/channels.json) · [Video metadata](results/videos.json) · [Video comments](results/comments.json) · [Shorts' metadata](results/shorts.json) · [Search](results/search.json) · [Transcripts](results/transcripts.json)

## Was gescrapt wird

- YouTube-Video-Metadaten
- YouTube-Videokommentare
- YouTube-Kanal-Metadaten
- YouTube-Kanalvideos
- YouTube-Suche
- YouTube-Shorts-Metadaten

## Funktionen

- `scrape_video(ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape video metadata from YouTube videos
- `scrape_comments(video_id, max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scraper comments from a YouTube video
- `scrape_channel(channel_ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape channel metadata from YouTube channel pages
- `scrape_channel_videos(channel_id, sort_by='Latest', max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape video metadata from YouTube channel page
- `scrape_search(search_query, max_scrape_pages=None, search_params=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape search results from YouTube search query
- `scrape_shorts(ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape metadata from YouTube shorts
- `scrape_transcript(video_ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape transcript segments (start and end time in milliseconds and text) of YouTube videos

Die Funktionen sind `async`: Aufruf mit `asyncio.run(...)` oder per `await`.

### Beispiel

Die Eingaben sind die Beispiele aus [`run.py`](run.py) (lange Listen gekürzt):

```python
import asyncio
import youtube


async def main():
    video = await youtube.scrape_video(ids=["1Y-XvvWlyzk", "muo6I9XY8K4"])
    comments = await youtube.scrape_comments(video_id="FgakZw6K1QQ", max_scrape_pages=3)
    channel = await youtube.scrape_channel(channel_ids=["scrapfly"])
    channel_videos = await youtube.scrape_channel_videos(
        channel_id="statquest",
        sort_by="Latest",
        max_scrape_pages=2,
    )
    search = await youtube.scrape_search(
        search_query="python",
        search_params="EgQIAxAB",
        max_scrape_pages=2,
    )
    shorts = await youtube.scrape_shorts(ids=["rZ2qqtNPSBk"])
    transcript = await youtube.scrape_transcript(video_ids=["x7X9w_GIm1s"])


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Ausgabe

Die Funktionen geben einfache Dictionaries und Listen zurück. Felder der Beispielausgabe (Schlüssel der obersten Ebene des ersten Eintrags):

- [`results/channel_videos.json`](results/channel_videos.json): `videoId`, `title`, `publishedTime`, `viewCount`, `lengthText`, `thumbnails`, `url`
- [`results/channels.json`](results/channels.json): `description`, `url`, `subscriberCount`, `videoCount`, `viewCount`, `joinedDate`, `country`, `links`
- [`results/videos.json`](results/videos.json): `video`, `channel`, `commentContinuationToken`
- [`results/comments.json`](results/comments.json): `comment`, `author`, `stats`
- [`results/shorts.json`](results/shorts.json): `videoId`, `title`, `lengthSeconds`, `channelId`, `isOwnerViewing`, `shortDescription`, `isCrawlable`, `thumbnail`, `allowRatings`, `viewCount`, `author`, `isPrivate`, `isUnpluggedCorpus`, `isLiveContent`, `isTvfilmVideo`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `title`, `description`, `publishedTime`, `videoLength`, `viewCount`, `videoBadges`, `channelBadges`, `videoThumbnails`, `channelThumbnails`, `url`
- [`results/transcripts.json`](results/transcripts.json): `videoId`, `startMs`, `endMs`, `text`

## Scrapfly-Einstellungen

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`youtube.py`](youtube.py) enthält die Standardeinstellungen der Anfragen, siehe die [Scrape API-Dokumentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapflys [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), die Umgehung von Anti-Bot-Schutz
- `country` = `"US"`: Land des Proxys

## Schnellstart

Benötigt Python 3.10+ und [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/youtube-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # von https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # Beispiel-Scrape, speichert die Ausgabe in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # die Tests dieses Scrapers
```

Tests: `test_video_scraping`, `test_comment_scraping`, `test_channel_scraping`, `test_channel_videos_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_shorts_scraping`, `test_transcript_scraping`; einen einzelnen ausführen mit `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` und die Tests scrapen die Live-Website und verbrauchen daher Scrapfly-Credits.
